text:
devin: Heads up — OrbitRack flagged a split shipment on our EU Dedicated reservation. ~60% of the racks clear customs tomorrow, ~40% pushed to next-week manifest. This affects the Q3 marketplace ramp for eu-west. @marie any visibility from partner comms?
marie: saw the note. partner says "manifest split due to port congestion" and they can do partial reroute but it costs extra. trying to get a firm ETA for the late batch.
samir: which SKUs/GPU types and which DCs? need to know compatibility for quick fallback.
devin: SKUs: ORB-RK-GPU-A100-80G x24, ORB-RK-GPU-A100-40G x8. Primary -> eu-west-1 (staging racks), fallback -> eu-central-3. PO# 842199-ER. snippet of manifest: ```
manifest_id: M-842199
dest: eu-west-1 (staging)
items:
  - ORB-RK-GPU-A100-80G: 24
  - ORB-RK-GPU-A100-40G: 8
status: split (60% -> ship, 40% -> delay)
```
jess: ok. two separate issues: (1) customer-facing capacity hit for those with Dedicated commits, (2) marketplace listing that expects capacity for launch. we should triage both.
nana: (ana) list of impacted customers? i can draft emails and offer temporary hosted overlay for highest-risk tenants. also can we provide credits if SLAable?
samir: technical fallbacks: we can 1) temporarily route EU marketplace allocations to hosted pool (latency hit) 2) enable cross-region failover to eu-central-3 if partner can reroute quickly 3) soft-throttle commit customers (reduce guaranteed concurrency) while we rebalance. option 1 and 3 are fastest.
devin: partner offered reroute to eu-central-3 but need signoff on customs/extra freight. they said ~48h from signoff. cost TBD.
ops-bot: shipping update: M-842199 partial shipment scanned: 60% cleared departure (ETA eu-west-1 2026-04-02). Remaining 40% awaiting port slot (no ETA).
jess: proposed contingency plan (short):
  1) sign off reroute for late batch to eu-central-3 only if partner confirms <72h (Owner: marie, deadline: +2h)
  2) migrate marketplace reserved inventory to hosted overlay while we confirm hardware (Owner: samir, deadline: +4h)
  3) Notify top 5 commit customers, offer hosted overlay or credit (Owner: ana, deadline: +3h)
  4) If partner asks for emergency expedite, approve up to $Xk for freight (Owner: finance-oncall via jess, deadline: +6h)
  5) Postmortem / root cause + landing doc after ramp (Owner: jess, deadline: next-week MWF)

marie: confirmed i'll get partner to price the reroute and ETA within 90 minutes.
samir: starting inventory check now — estimating we can cover ~25% of affected capacity from our spare pool and hosted overlay. will post numbers in 30m.
nana: drafting the customer notice, will include options + timeline. ping me if you want specific customers prioritized.
devin: great. small ask: label any temporary hosted allocations with tag `temp-reroute-1779994444` so billing/ops can track.
ops-bot: tag created: temp-reroute-1779994444 by samir
jess: thanks all. if we can get partner ETA <48h we probably avoid major churn. if not, we'll execute hosted overlay + credits. :thumbsup:
marie: @devin i also asked them to confirm whether future shipments will be split for other orders — will escalate in that thread.
devin: excellent. i'll keep this thread live for updates. :eyes:
